claims: Bully is Kanye West's 12th studio album.
Bully is scheduled for release on March 27, 2026.
Bully had previous unfulfilled release dates.
Bully has a sound reminiscent of 808s & Heartbreak and My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
Bully will be released via YZY and Gamma.
Bully's sound is described as emotional and melodic.
Bully's sound is reminiscent of Kanye West's 2008-2010 era.
Bully is produced by Kanye West, 1srael, Adey, and others.
Bully has no AI usage, according to Kanye.
Bully includes the songs "Preacher Man", "Beauty and the Beast", "Damn", and "Last Breath".
Performances for Bully are set for April 1 and April 3 in Inglewood, California.
Bully was produced in Tokyo and Mallorca.
Bully was produced following Kanye West's work on Vultures 2.
